request.prompt:
You are implementing ONE change to this application.

FIRST read AGENTS.md — it states the working rules and how the app is tested, and sends you to
DESIGN.md for this implementation's stack and conventions. Follow both.

THE CHANGE REQUEST:
If a sent invoice has no payments yet, let me still change it: adding a line or changing the
discount puts it back to Draft, so it has to be sent again, and writes an audit line
INVOICE_REOPENED id=<id>. Once any payment has been recorded against it, keep refusing
changes.

Your work is verified by an automated Playwright UI test already installed under e2e/specs/.
Read that spec: it declares the exact data-testid anchors, values, test data and any audit
records it expects — match them. Run `bin/e2e` to build the app, start it, and run the test as
you work; iterate until it passes. Change whatever the request needs across the app — its stored
data, its server and its front end. Do NOT edit bin/build, bin/start, bin/stop, bin/e2e,
AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, DESIGN.md, e2e/support/ or the test spec.

agent.result_text:
Sent invoices with no payments can now be changed. Adding a line or changing the discount puts the invoice back to Draft, so it has to be sent again, and writes `INVOICE_REOPENED id=<id>` to the audit file. Once any payment has been recorded, changes are still refused. `bin/e2e` passes both tests, including the replay of earlier test data.

**What changed (server only):**
- **`InvoiceService.java`:** adding a line and setting the discount now share one check:
  - a draft is changed as before;
  - a sent invoice with no payments goes back to Draft, and the audit line is written only after the change has saved;
  - an invoice with any payment is refused, with the message "A paid invoice cannot take new lines." or "A paid invoice cannot be given a discount."
- **`Invoice.java`:** a new `reopen()` sets the status back to `DRAFT`.

The front end needed no code changes. The panel already shows the server's error messages and the new status, and the invoice list already picks up the status change. I only updated the panel's header comment to describe the new behaviour.
